Name: Smooth Movement Overhaul
Author: houlvex
Description:
Finally, the movement overhaul Stardew Valley needed! If you ever found traversal a bit rigid and clunky, this mod completely reimagines how your farmer moves and interacts with the world, bringing modern indie-game responsiveness and fluidity.
Key Features
[list]
[*][b]True Vaulting (Spacebar):[/b] Finally jump over all those annoying obstacles! Clear small stones, twigs, weeds, and single-tile fences effortlessly instead of running all the way around them.[/*]
[*][b]Fluid Dash (Left Shift):[/b] Tap Left Shift to burst forward with a dynamic speed trail and smooth acceleration.[/*]
[*][b]Cinematic Smooth Camera:[/b] Rebuilt viewport tracking that gently follows your character with subtle lead and lag—zero screen stutter or harsh stops.[/*]
[*][b]Dynamic Tilt & Squash/Stretch:[/b] Visual physics integrated directly into your sprite; your character subtly leans into turns and squashes/stretches slightly when sprinting, landing, and dashing.[/*]
[*][b]Skid & Turn Deceleration:[/b] Abruptly reversing direction triggers a satisfying skid effect with dust particles instead of an instant mechanical snap.[/*]
[*][b]Corner Sliding:[/b] Glancing collisions against fence edges or trees smoothly glide you around the corner rather than stopping you dead in your tracks.[/*]
[/list]Controls & Configuration
[list]
[*][b]Left Shift:[/b] Dash[/*]
[*][b]Spacebar:[/b] Jump / Vault over obstacles[/*]
[/list]Requirements
[list]
[*][b]SMAPI[/b] (v4.0.0 or higher)[/*]
[*]Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[/list]Installation
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [b]SMAPI[/b].[/*]
[*]Download this mod and unzip
[code]SmoothMovement[/code]into your
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game using SMAPI and enjoy![/*]
[/list]

Manifest.Description: Overhauls player movement with smooth inertia, corner sliding, dash mechanic, and responsive animations.
